title: populus deltoides subsp. wislizeni
intro: Populus deltoides subsp. wislizeni, commonly known as Fremont cottonwood or Rio Grande cottonwood, is a subspecies of deciduous tree native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Populus deltoides subsp. wislizeni include pain relief, wound healing, and protection against oxidative stress, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The plant's bioactive constituents have been shown to exhibit potential in preventing or treating conditions such as cancer, cardiovascular disease, and neurodegenerative disorders.
